Definition: a primary word; "fire" (literally or figuratively, specially, lightning):--fiery, fire.
BiblicalUsage: Pyr is fire, the flame that burns, refines, and judges. John the Baptist said Christ shall baptize you with the Holy Ghost, and with fire, and Hebrews says our God is a consuming fire. The tongue is a fire, a world of iniquity, and behold how great a matter a little fire kindleth, and death and hell were cast into the lake of fire, which is the second death.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe fire is the Bible's most two-sided word: it baptizes and it burns, it refines the gold and it consumes the chaff. I hold that the same God who is a consuming fire is the One who baptizes with fire, and the difference between the two fires is whether I come to Him in repentance or in rebellion.
RelatedPeople: John the Baptist; Jesus; James, Brother of Jesus
